5088.title: Connect mobile waits on stalled HTTP responses
5088.rootCauseOneLine: Connect redemption/session requests lack application deadlines; a stalled local HTTP response leaves enrollment pending and session authenticating. The Android LTE transport trigger remains unknown.
5088.proposedFix: Capture sanitized native DNS/TCP/TLS/request/response timing across Wi-Fi and LTE before changing the transport. A bounded cancelable deadline may improve errors but does not establish an LTE fix.
5088.caveats: Partial mechanism only, verified by the same agent in two clean checkouts. No Android device/runtime or LTE network available; Node loopback HTTP does not reproduce the cellular-versus-Chrome difference. No production fix PR.
